summary: Seven unique Columbus industrial refinance opportunities meet the criteria as of the 2026-08-31 cutoff. All shortlisted loans are active_confirmed with executed-note maturities between 2027-01-15 and 2027-07-15, no executed extensions, record ownership verified on/after 2026-03-01, and a current Director of Finance contact verified in 2026. Two base records (R2362 and R7391) were eligible duplicates for Cypress Park 1; one (R7391) was retained. One candidate (R3389) was excluded due to an executed amendment extending maturity to 2028-09-30 (U-R3389-1). Several others were excluded for unconfirmed/inferred maturities, unresolved extension options, released/unknown loan status, stale ownership verification, contact role/tenure misalignment, or out-of-scope asset/market. Prospect CSV/XLSX generation is not included in this response; the shortlisted facts and source_ids support downstream file creation.
limitations: Outstanding balances are not provided (null) across the dataset; sizing relies on original principal only.
Shortlist ranking breaks ties only by the stated rules (maturity asc, then original principal desc); no secondary tiebreaker specified.
Deduplication for CYPRESS-REF-62661 favored record R7391 over R2362; both share identical facts and verification timing.
Results reflect the evidence effective on or before the 2026-08-31 cutoff; later-dated changes (e.g., any releases or amendments after cutoff) are not considered.
All contact and ownership roles are taken solely from the supplied extracts; no external validation of titles or corporate hierarchy.
